_comment: PLAN-ICEBERG item 7 (docs/progress/iceberg-release.md, 2026-10-30): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to tools/maps/iceberg.json; emits base.json 'exits'. The client authors the ExfiltrationPoint objects at runtime from ArenaMapRegistry.Iceberg.Exits (ArenaMapPort.Shared/ArenaMapDescriptor.cs): names, positions and box sizes there must equal this file. 2026-10-30 candidates (SUPERSEDED 2026-11-12): one gate OUTSIDE each pocket, East (72.0, 1.95, -94.0) in the yard west of GATES_A, West (-30.5, 2.92, -85.0) in the corridor east of GATES_B, at least 10 m from every player spawn row. 2026-11-12 (user request, lead decision R3; host-checked on GPU-2 2026-11-12 (docs/progress/spawn-rows-and-pocket-exits.md): '[Exfil] authored exit' put East Gate 0.2 m from the authored position (NavMesh-sampled within 1 m), both flares were seen, and Team Deathmatch ran with a Bear start inside the east box; not checked: a respawn onto an in-box marker, the flares from across the map): every map has one exit per team pocket and the box (4 x 3 x 4 m, rotation 0) stands INSIDE its pocket, with its centre inside the pocket's initial spawn-bound footprint of tools/maps/iceberg.modes.json, so that the green signal flare (ExfilSignals) marks the team's spawn area in ArenaMode's team modes, where extraction is disabled. East (90.88, 1.67, -86.34) is the Bear pocket behind GATES_A, on the upper west part of the ramp (it falls from y 1.9 to 0.75), with the marker Bear house (9) inside; West (-38.79, 3.2, -85.6) is the Usec pocket behind GATES_B, flat floor, with the marker Usec house (11) inside. Every player spawn row keeps at least 2.5 m to the box edge (the Equator booth precedent, docs/progress/equator-booth-spawns.md): East 2.70 m from Player (all) and 6.5 m from Player (bear), West 3.56 m from Player (usec) and 4.68 m from Player (west-all), so a plain-raid spawn does not start inside a trigger; the floor is NavMesh under the centre and no solid stands in the box. Accepted consequences: in a plain SPT raid a player now spawns a few metres from an 8 s exit; with the developer gate hold (Spawns/SpawnGateHold) a held team can reach its exit before the release; neither pocket has held gates, so both exits are reachable in a plain raid. Bots never trigger exits (empty EntryPoint). The names East Gate and West Gate stay (locale keys) but no longer describe the position. EntryPoints is always the map's infiltration name; names double as locale keys.
